\## Description

Fixes # (issue number)



\## Type of change

\- \[ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)

\- \[ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)

\## PR Checklist

\- \[ ] I have run `make lint` and formatting checks pass.

\- \[ ] I have run `make test` and all tests pass locally.

\- \[ ] I have run `make tutorial` (if applicable).

\- \[ ] I have updated docstrings and added new modules/functions to `\_\_all\_\_` (if applicable).

\- \[ ] My changes are consistent with the guidelines in `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
